provider: Audiovisual / heritage: Open Heritage 3D (CyArk + UC San Diego CHEI)

free_tier.stated: No published quota. The project is a consortium repository — 'we invite others to join the Open Heritage 3D project and contribute their datasets' — with 200+ datasets and DOIs under the 10.26301 prefix. Contribution is by organisational agreement, not self-serve signup.

egress.terms: Each project page lists its data types with sizes (10.3 GB of terrestrial LiDAR on a sampled project) and states that links to all available data types are emailed; no metering is stated.

tooling: Web catalogue with per-project pages and DOI resolution; no public upload API and no documented deposit endpoint. Joining requires contacting the consortium (CHEI at UCSD, CyArk, Politecnico di Torino G4CH, Washington and Lee).
chaining: Not chainable by an individual — the unit is an institutional partnership. A single organisation could contribute many datasets, but the door is a consortium agreement.

limits_note: Organisational membership required; heritage-3D scope (photogrammetry, laser scan, point clouds); no published per-file or total figures at all.

reliability_note: Stable academic consortium with DOI permanence and mirrored preservation, but there is no self-service path — this is a partnership, not a storage provider.
